caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a domed, patterned stopper. The jug is predominantly colored in shades of gray with accents of blue, especially on the decorative elements and the stopper. Two large, symmetrical handles are attached on either side of the neck, each curling outward and upward. The surface of the jug is adorned with ornate decorations, including floral motifs and swirling patterns, which are highlighted in blue. There are also representations of hands and leaves, as well as rosette-like circular designs distributed around the main body of the jug. The base is ringed with a band of circular and twisted rope-like patterns in blue. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, detailed sketch showing the jug’s label or inscription, shaped like a shield, containing text and decorative elements. The drawing is set against a plain background, and a thin rectangular border encloses the main image.
title: Jug with Stopper
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
